item.content:encoded: I like the formats, I'm a bit worried that these cells are so self-aware, and even call themselves "Fifthist". IMHC the phenomenon just occurs out of something else, they don't give it a name, or realize they're a part of it. That being said, a lot of this territory has already been explored. It's not really expanding on the effect it has on these people are what the entity is all about, unless I'm not catching something.

item.content:encoded:
Okay, here's the thing.

There are five branches of Fifthism and three of them are never mentioned or discussed. The other two have separate formats; the Starfish people have their song lyrics with conversation, the Southerners have the five-verse cutout poem things. I'm postulating here that there is an East Coast (originally) and urban (generally) Fifthist church sect called the Five Cities branch; this is a product of theirs. It's written in a RapGenius-style annotated lyric sheet.

i'm so sorry if this sucks
